description:
Jewelry designer Park Eun-Hyeon is looking for someone to help him make a ring when an acquaintance introduces him to a craftsman with quick hands. Eun-Hyeon, who desperately needs help with an urgent deadline, goes to meet him right away... The person who appears in front of her is Kang Yu-Chan, his junior and partner from college. He worries for a moment that Yu-Chan will cling to him like he did back then, but the collaboration between the two seems smooth...

 *"Senior, it's been a while since you've written something, right?"*

Eun-Hyeon is helplessly falling for him who seduces him with his perfect face..! In the meantime, the deadline is approaching! 

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
